# Draft QEVA constitution 0.1

## Purpose

QEVA exists to preserve and connect explicit mathematical definitions, assumptions, claims, derivations, counterexamples, open questions, source history, and verification artifacts so that any future reader can understand, challenge, reproduce, and extend them.

## Permanent commitments

1. Public exact revisions are never silently altered or made unreachable by a later correction.
2. Provenance, qualification state, and known disputes remain attached to each record.
3. The complete public archive, protocol, schemas, and reference software remain openly downloadable without an account.
4. Anyone may maintain a complete mirror or a compatible fork.
5. Contributor credit is permanent; no contributor or institution owns truth status.
6. Historical influence, bibliographic citation, logical dependence, and editorial relation remain distinct edge layers.
7. Imported material retains its source rights. Unknown rights remain unknown.

## Powers of the steward

The steward may publish a named canonical release, maintain identifiers and schemas, appoint transparent editorial bodies, reject or defer submissions with stated reasons, correct interfaces, and coordinate custody. Canonical status is a service mark of process, never a claim of infallibility.

## Limits

The steward may not retroactively modify an exact revision; require proprietary software to interpret the canonical core; prohibit lawful copying, mirroring, criticism, or forking; use popularity as a verification state; convert a citation into a logical dependency without review; or erase a refutation, dissent, or correction merely because it is embarrassing.

## Decisions and conflicts

Material changes require a public proposal, exact affected identifiers, alternatives considered, conflict disclosures, evidence, a review period, a reasoned decision, preserved dissent, and an appeal route. Technical emergencies may be mitigated immediately but the action expires unless publicly ratified.

## Succession

Independent mirror custodians maintain current succession contacts and annual recovery evidence. If the steward is unreachable for twelve months, fails two declared releases without an explanation, or materially breaches the permanent commitments, three independent custodians from at least two jurisdictions may witness a successor branch. They preserve all prior identifiers and publish the evidence, decision, and compatibility boundary.

## Amendment

Operational provisions may be amended by the public process. The permanent commitments can be changed only by creating a clearly named successor constitution and namespace; the prior archive and its fork rights remain available.
